posts.text:
Five citizenship cost comparisons for one main applicant.

Dominica: USD 200,000 fund + 4 fees = USD 210,000. Subtotals exclude unlisted professional, document and transaction costs.
posts.alt: Citizenship directory cards compare costs for one main applicant. Dominica: USD 200,000 EDF contribution plus four fees totaling USD 10,000 gives a USD 210,000 subtotal. Egypt: USD 500,000 deposit capital plus USD 10,000 application fee; capital is repaid in EGP. Unlisted professional, document and transaction costs are extra.

posts.text:
Dominica EDF: USD 200,000 + 1,000 processing + 7,500 due diligence + 500 certificate + 1,000 interview = USD 210,000.

Agent, passport, bank and any enhanced-check costs are extra.
posts.alt: Dominica flag and single-applicant cost table in USD: EDF contribution 200,000; processing 1,000; due diligence 7,500; naturalisation certificate 500; interview 1,000. Subtotal: 210,000. Agent, passport, bank and any enhanced-check costs are extra.

posts.text:
Antigua and Barbuda NDF, single applicant:
USD 230,000 + 10,000 processing + 8,500 due diligence + 300 passport = USD 248,800.

Agent charges extra.
posts.alt: Antigua and Barbuda flag and single-applicant cost table in USD: NDF contribution 230,000; processing 10,000; due diligence 8,500; passport 300. Subtotal: 248,800, with agent charges extra.

posts.text:
Sao Tome and Principe: USD 90,000 donation + 5,000 submission + 750 citizenship documents = USD 95,750 before agent costs.

Sponsored applications add USD 5,000 benefactor due diligence.
posts.alt: Sao Tome and Principe flag and single-applicant cost table in USD: donation 90,000; submission 5,000; citizenship documents 750. Subtotal: 95,750. Documents include registration certificate, passport and national ID. Sponsored applications add 5,000 for benefactor due diligence; agent costs are extra.

posts.text:
Saint Lucia bonds: USD 300,000 capital + 50,000 administration + 2,000 processing + 8,000 due diligence = USD 360,000 before other costs.

Bonds earn no interest and must be held 5 years; fees are separate.
posts.alt: Saint Lucia flag and single-applicant bond costs in USD: capital 300,000; administration 50,000; processing 2,000; due diligence 8,000. Subtotal: 360,000. Bonds must be held 5 years and earn no interest; fees are separate from capital. A declaration of at least USD 350,000 in financial resources also applies. Other costs excluded.

posts.text:
Egypt: USD 500,000 Central Bank deposit + USD 10,000 non-refundable application fee = USD 510,000 upfront.

Deposit repaid after 3 years in Egyptian pounds at the Central Bank rate on repayment, without interest.

facebook.caption:
Five citizenship cost comparisons for one main applicant.

Dominica: USD 200,000 fund + 4 fees = USD 210,000. Subtotals exclude unlisted professional, document and transaction costs.

1. Dominica EDF: USD 200,000 + 1,000 processing + 7,500 due diligence + 500 certificate + 1,000 interview = USD 210,000.

Agent, passport, bank and any enhanced-check costs are extra.

2. Antigua and Barbuda NDF, single applicant:
USD 230,000 + 10,000 processing + 8,500 due diligence + 300 passport = USD 248,800.

Agent charges extra.

3. Sao Tome and Principe: USD 90,000 donation + 5,000 submission + 750 citizenship documents = USD 95,750 before agent costs.

Sponsored applications add USD 5,000 benefactor due diligence.

4. Saint Lucia bonds: USD 300,000 capital + 50,000 administration + 2,000 processing + 8,000 due diligence = USD 360,000 before other costs.

Bonds earn no interest and must be held 5 years; fees are separate.

5. Egypt: USD 500,000 Central Bank deposit + USD 10,000 non-refundable application fee = USD 510,000 upfront.

Deposit repaid after 3 years in Egyptian pounds at the Central Bank rate on repayment, without interest.
